initial_state: Use ../F01C_MIRACLE/seed-current.bin as data/CURRENT.BIN in each fresh disposable DOS root. The 378-byte seed positions the avatar at the GOESnet console and contains no selected target. Its provenance and byte-level derivation are in the F01C manifest. Each accepted ST run starts from this same seed, not from the PAR run's save.
steps: Copy pinned data/, modules/, and dosbox.conf into a new disposable directory and verify the reference hashes. Copy ../F01C_MIRACLE/seed-current.bin to data/CURRENT.BIN and verify its hash. Do not use the tracked checkout as the DOS working directory.

Launch DOSBox-X with the disposable root mounted as N:, switch to N:, cd modules, and run NOCTIS.EXE; press Enter if the boot screen waits. When the GOESnet console is active, press Home and Backspace as needed to clear the input line.

For a separate query run, type PAR NEW FELYSIA and press Enter. Wait for the 147-byte GOES STARMAP ANALYSIS output; preserve data/GOESFILE.TXT as par-new-felysia.txt. This establishes displayed coordinates but is not one of the two accepted target-save runs.

For each of two fresh target runs, type ST NEW FELYSIA and press Enter. Wait until the 147-byte LOOKING FOR TARGET output appears and data/COMM.BIN has been consumed. Preserve the output as st-new-felysia.txt. The module's STARTING VIMANA DRIVE text alone is not evidence that the game saved a target.

Allow the game to resume, then press Escape for a normal save/exit. If the game has not yet exited and the save still has ap_targetted=0, wait for the ST module to release keyboard control and press Escape again. Accept only a normal-exit save with ap_targetted=1 and the target fields below. Compare the two accepted saves with extract_current_target.py; do not compare whole saves byte-for-byte.

replay_save.usage: Copy to data/CURRENT.BIN only in a disposable DOS root with the pinned reference inputs; this is a captured engaged-target state, not a byte-exact golden for future runs.

excluded_run: An initial PAR run produced correct displayed coordinates, but later ST keystrokes were not accepted by that DOSBox session. Its pre-target save (SHA-256 72dcc0d1936773ed6c83598b34d01e68676877fe789b0a8a822af80a82bf560f) has ap_targetted=0 and is not counted among the direct repetitions.
comparison_level: EXACT saved coordinates, class, RGB, spin, radius f32 bits, and raw GOESnet output; TOLERANT starmap double ID; STRUCTURAL on-screen presentation
notes: Two accepted ST-only runs from the same seed agree on every target field. Their whole-save hashes differ because other state is time-dependent; the included replay save is evidence and a resume point, not a byte-exact golden. GOESnet PAR displays positive Y by convention while the internal saved Y is negative. The sector origin is inferred by matching DOS's saved coordinates to the native sector function; DOS does not serialize it. NEW FELYSIA is the star's starmap label; F02A separately establishes that the FELYSIA planet belongs to BALASTRACKONASTREYA, not this star.
